title: Basic
description: Segmented tabs, each child rendering its trigger and its panel. The selected value binds both ways; without one, the first enabled tab is selected.

title: Underline with counts
description: The underline variant, for tabs under a PageHeader, with a count, a disabled tab and manual activation: the arrow keys move focus and Enter or Space selects.

title: From data
description: tabs renders the same children as composition. Small tabs suit filters and view switches.
